observations: Photo 0: A car tire lying flat on a tiled floor, tread pattern visible, sidewall markings not legible, a finger pointing at the tire, part of another tire visible at the top edge.
Photo 1: Same tire as photo 0 from a similar angle, watermark 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' across the tread, finger pointing at the lower right edge.
Photo 2: Two tires stacked, the top tire shows sidewall lettering that reads 'MASTERCOURT', the bottom tire shows tread only, watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' visible.

claims.evidence: Photos show used tires but cannot confirm grade or foreign-used origin remotely.

claims.claim: will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: Future performance and remaining life cannot be judged from still photos.

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining life unknown; tire may be near the legal limit or worn unevenly.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a tread depth gauge inserted in multiple grooves, or a video showing tread wear indicators.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn out or near end of life

risks.risk: Internal damage, bead damage, or hidden repairs not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: Video of the tire inflated and rotated, or close-up of the bead and inner liner if demounted.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or unsafe

risks.risk: Manufacturing age unknown; rubber may be old and hardened even if tread looks good.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the DOT date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: priced as old rubber with reduced lifespan

risks.risk: Brand or model misread; sidewall text may not be 'MASTERCOURT'.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photo of the full sidewall branding.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded car tire

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full sidewall showing all branding and the DOT date code
Photo of tread depth measured with a gauge in at least three spots
Video showing the tire inflated and rotated to check for bulges or bead issues
response.reason: The photos show a used car tire with a readable sidewall brand in photo 2, so it can be priced at its worst case as a second-hand tire with unknown tread depth, age, and internal condition.
